newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-NAB cuts prime rate to 8.6 percent.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-NAB cuts prime rate to 8.6 percent.

text.p: National Australia Bank Ltd, Australia's largest bank, said on Friday it would cut its prime business lending rate to 8.6 percent from 9.1 percent, effective August 4.
NAB said it base reference rate would be cut to 8.75 percent from 9.25 percent from September 8.

"The adjustment in business rates would support the investment plans of business and assist an improvement in the growth of the Australian economy," NAB Chief General Manager Frank Cicutto said in a statement.
The reduction in business lending rates follows the Reserve Bank of Australia's 0.5 percentage point cut in official cash interest rates to 5.00 percent on Wednesday.
